about: Entersight-wide audit policy. scripts/audit.mjs merges this with the project's own .entersight-audit.json (repo root): the project's brand fields and rules override these, its exceptions and decisions are added. Every finding whose id is listed under rules is re-levelled to fail / warn / allow, with the reason shown in the report. Ids not listed keep the meter's own level. Change a rule with a reason; never argue with a meter in a report.

brand.voice: Plain Vietnamese, said the way the founder says it on the first call. Customer's words over agency words. Every number has a source on the page.
brand.motion: Quiet. Native scroll, one short reveal, press/hover feedback. Emil Kowalski's standards (skill review-animations, STANDARDS.md) decide motion, not the upstream 'at least 8 moving elements' rule.

palette-purple.why: Blue-violet (#5549de / #4a3aff) is the Entersight brand colour, not a generated default.

purple.why: Same as palette-purple, for the source scan.

default-font.why: Montserrat + Roboto are the brand faces (SVN-Gotham substitute).

overused-font.why: Roboto is the brand body face (Impeccable lists it as overused).

font-not-dealt.why: No dealt direction; the brand fixes the faces.

still-page.why: Motion is deliberately quiet; judged by review-animations instead.

no-footage.why: No honest clip of the subject exists; never add stock video to fill the slot.

few-pictures.why: Only real project/product pictures count; never pad with stock.

eyebrow.why: Entersight decision 2026-10-25: no labels above headings. Fold real information into the heading or the first sentence.

numbering.why: Entersight decision 2026-10-25: no decorative 01/02. A real sequence is written in words ('Bước 1') inside an <ol>.

micro-label.why: Tiny tracked caps only inside interface fragments (data-ui) and form fields.

hairline.why: Rules may separate list rows and form fields; decorative dividers go.

outlined-box.why: Outlined buttons are part of the brand system; outlined cards are not.

glass.why: One sticky bar may blur; nothing else.

touch-target.why: Inline and footer links under 24px pass WCAG 2.2 (2.5.8) when spaced apart; buttons and nav links must be ≥24px.

em-dash.why: Counted per file, in Vietnamese copy, by scripts/lint-vi.mjs instead.

decisions.decision: Brand palette and fonts are exempt from the upstream palette/font bans.
Motion follows Emil Kowalski's standards; the upstream minimum-motion rule is off.
Eyebrows and decorative 01/02 numbering are dropped site-wide. Real sequences keep their order in words.
Impeccable's detector binary is not run (external code is blocked in cloud sessions); its rule catalog is vendored and probe.mjs measures what it can.
